name: stream-yours
description: Stream Yours' — free peer-to-peer movie & series streaming over WebRTC. Static site + optional TURN function for Cloudflare Pages.
author: Sanchar Koirala

scripts.check: node --check app.js && node --check sw.js && node scripts/build.mjs --check
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=stream-yours
scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=stream-yours --branch=preview
